svg.title: Who runs Renovate
svg.desc: The answer renovate_runner decides who runs Renovate for a repository. The blueprint's owner keeps the hub, the Renovate workflow of the blueprint, which runs it for each of the owner's repositories on which the release app is installed. Every other owner gets a Renovate workflow in the repository itself, which runs it every two hours as the release app, for that repository alone, with the same Renovate and the same rules; or installs the Mend Renovate app, which needs no workflow and comes at every push. Each way reads the rules of .github/renovate.json5 and opens the updates as pull requests, whose checks decide whether they merge.
